prompt:

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. A calm adult gently holds a lively dog’s harness and short leash to keep it from running into the road, without hurting it.
en: The adult restrains the dog from running into the road.
